title: Ferryland folk-arts building addition, tea-room ramp, and principal entrance
code_edition: Buildings Accessibility Act and Buildings Accessibility Regulations; edition not stated

facts.text: The decision analyzes a 2017 project described as a new entrance and addition for a staircase, with a ramp connecting a tea room and the rest of the building.
It cites Buildings Accessibility Act section 7(3) and Buildings Accessibility Regulations sections 7 and 9(3)(a) regarding alterations and principal entrances.
The board distinguishes the 2017 renovation from a claimed simple replacement of a 2004 ramp.
